subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw make `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` plus the locked-harness owner-handoff reset hook a permanent public Plugin SDK contract for Teams and future channel lifecycle resets?
rationale: The Teams bug fix is credible, but the selected implementation creates a reusable public session-lifecycle contract rather than remaining entirely within the Teams owner boundary.

options.title: Keep the SDK contract
options.body: Accept the generic lifecycle-reset primitive and owner handoff as supported Plugin SDK behavior, then merge after final merge-result validation.

options.title: Narrow the fix to the owner boundary
options.body: Rework the Teams fix to use an existing supported path or a narrower internal seam if a public reset contract is not intended.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle API design
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define the durable lifecycle and harness-reset contract for plugins.

recommendation.title: Narrow the fix to the owner boundary
recommendation.body: Rework the Teams fix to use an existing supported path or a narrower internal seam if a public reset contract is not intended.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history and timeline show direct involvement in the Teams lifecycle scoping relevant to this API choice.
